items.title: CSV export breaks when a customer name contains a comma
items.claim: ordersToCsv joins raw fields with commas, so a customer name with a comma shifts columns in /orders/export.csv
items.reason: premise false on main: fields are already quoted per RFC 4180 and both acceptance criteria are met
items.evidence: commit 1b58281 on main; src/export.ts:5-7 quotes fields matching [",\r\n]; test/export.test.ts:24-27 covers a name with a comma and a quote; vitest 12/12 passing on 2026-10-17

items.title: Stream the CSV export instead of building it in memory
items.claim: ordersToCsv builds the whole CSV as one string before /orders/export.csv sends it, so memory grows with order count
items.reason: real (src/export.ts:14-24, src/server.ts:37-43) but low impact: OrderStore already holds every order in memory, so the CSV string at most doubles a footprint that is small at demo scale

items.title: Reject zero or negative quantities when creating an order
items.claim: OrderStore.create accepts a line with quantity 0 or negative, producing a zero or negative order total
items.reason: real: src/orders.ts:42-58 validates only customer and line count; highest-scoring open item and the first pick when a sprint is selected; consider non-integer quantities in the same check
